claims.claim_text: Case Number: SC-027
Date of Incident: November 13, 2020
Time of Incident: Approximately 1615–1740 hours
Location: 7900 block of Adams Way, Anaheim, CA
Reporting Officer: Officer K. Abudeen
Badge Number: 5923
Subject: Marco Espinoza, Male, 22 years old, Hispanic, shaved head, dark clothing
Officer(s): Officer K. Abudeen, Officer D. Ramirez
APD helicopter "Angel"
multiple APD and BPPD patrol units

On November 13, 2020, at approximately 1645 hours, I was assigned to a perimeter position in connection with an ongoing search for a male suspect who had fled from officers on foot in the area of Adams Way and Grand Avenue.

The suspect had initially been the subject of a 911 call approximately fifteen minutes earlier reporting a male brandishing a firearm from a vehicle in the vicinity of a 7-Eleven parking lot near Beach Boulevard.
After officers located the suspect near the 7-Eleven, the suspect fled on foot
the suspect fled on foot, and after a brief foot pursuit was observed by the helicopter entering the yard of a residence on Adams Way
Officers established a perimeter
APD Sgt. McClintock then identified the suspect from a wanted flyer and broadcast the identification to units
Following this identification, helicopter officers began making public address announcements directing the suspect to exit the residence
Officer Ramirez and I took up a perimeter position in the backyard of 7914 Adams, located near the residence where the suspect was believed to be hiding
For roughly twenty minutes, repeated announcements were made from the helicopter in English only, directing the subject to come out with his hands up
During this time, the subject could be seen through the windows of 7896 Adams pacing on the ground floor
At approximately 1737 hours, I observed the subject exit from the front door of 7896 Adams and walk in the direction of our position at 7914 Adams
The encounter lasted approximately two minutes
As the subject entered the backyard, Officer Ramirez and I ordered him to show his hands
The subject initially raised his hands but almost immediately lowered both hands to his sides and took several quick steps toward us
At this point, believing the subject was armed and posed an imminent threat, I discharged my firearm five times
The subject fell to the ground approximately ten feet from our position
After the subject was down, Officer Ramirez and I approached and secured the subject in handcuffs
The subject had sustained gunshot wounds to both arms and his abdomen
We applied pressure bandages
Paramedics arrived within approximately two minutes and transported the subject to a local hospital, where he was treated and survived
No weapons or contraband were recovered from the subject's person or the immediate area
Body-worn camera footage (Officer Abudeen, Officer Ramirez)
Five (5) cartridge cases, Winchester 45 Auto
One (1) pair dark shorts
Crime scene photographs
Subject transported to hospital, underwent treatment, survived
Scene secured for OCDASAU investigation
Officer Signature: K. Abudeen
Date of Report: November 14, 2020
